supersedes.reason: batch433 tested one anonymous detail path and characterized the portal globally as roaming-only. Subsequent national extraction proved exact own-network FRGSP records expose live simpleTariff when the result set is filtered to Greenspot's own EVSE identity.

coverage.interpretation: CPO-method complete with station/EVSE fail-closed exceptions. Exact FRGSP live matches use first-party structured simpleTariff; unmatched inventory does not receive an invented direct tariff and uses TCC fallback when relevant.

sourceSemantics.firstPartyGreenspotOwnNetwork: Greenspot states that on its own network its badge adds no additional fee; the user pays the recharge cost displayed for the charger.
sourceSemantics.partnerRoaming: Partner-network connection/roaming fees remain eMSP-only and are excluded.
sourceSemantics.tariffProviderRule: tariffProvider=422 alone is not direct authority. A tariff is eligible only after exact own-network FRGSP EVSE filtering on the Greenspot tenant; non-FRGSP portal results are forbidden as Greenspot direct authority.

aldiSaintCiers.decision: fail_closed_direct; do not convert IRVE HT text into a TTC live tariff; use fallback if TCC needs a current public price

guards: Never treat tariffProvider 422 by itself as proof of CPO-direct pricing.
Only exact own-network FRGSP records from the Greenspot tenant are rankable as direct Greenspot values.
Do not inherit Yaway tariff IDs, app profile or prices.
Do not extrapolate any national constant across Greenspot.
Unmatched or ambiguous EVSEs stay fail-closed and use fallback rather than inferred prices.
